name: Control-Plane Query API
description: Define and implement a query API over PGlite that the tools, cockpit, and agents use. Replace direct database access.
purpose: Queries go through a governed interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Query API is a TypeScript module with typed functions
Covers all read queries currently used by tools, cockpit, and agents
API enforces authorization checks (who can read what)
API logs every query for audit
Migration from SQLite query helpers is complete — no direct SQLite access remains
API documentation is generated from JSDoc
